reason: X describes each exception as what Morgan does (duplicate row with empty new_filename and 'same as' note, over-500 review flag, UNKNOWN-DATE prefix but still filed, client-list type lookup) and states the rename-rule change with no retroactive renaming, staying faithful to the history (Paperwork/Inbox, Preview/TextEdit/Finder). Y gains from naming client-types.txt and giving timings, but wrongly ties the one-off HP printer driver install to the scan trigger (called an 'HP scanner'), only mentions missing-date and high-value in passing, undercounts days (3 vs 5), and has a non sequitur open question. Both undercount days and neither is perfect; X's correctness advantage decided it.
